feed.title: Faultline alerts: Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc.

entry.title: Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc.: Entered riskiest 5%
entry.summary: Bankruptcy risk entered the riskiest 5%: riskier than 96% of filers with the 10-Q filed 2020-09-10 (was 92%).

entry.title: Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc.: Risk jump
entry.summary: Bankruptcy risk rose from riskier than 64% to 92% of filers with the 10-Q filed 2020-06-11.

entry.title: Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc.: Going-concern wording
entry.summary: The new 10-K says events "raise substantial doubt" (going-concern wording); the previous 10-K did not.
